hypotheses.justification: If g = 0, `Place.ord_zero` (in `Definitions/Def_AlgebraicCurve_DivisorClassGroup.lean`) and hD give D v = 0 for every place v, hence D = 0 by extensionality of `Divisor`. Both lhs and rhs are additive homomorphisms, so they send 0 to 0. Thus the conclusion holds in this case too; the existing proof applies when g ≠ 0.
